scientific_integrity: All infinite-family conclusions are derived analytically; finite reproducibility assertions are corroborative. No external independent proof verification has been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Global uniqueness among unrestricted non-rotation-invariant matrices and finite-time mixing optimality are not claimed. Novelty search cannot exhaust nonindexed literature.
scientific_scope: All symmetric nonnegative stochastic matrices on loops and edges of Möbius ladder graphs having an even number of vertices at least eight; global SLEM optimal value and unique rotation-invariant optimum; comparison with corresponding Cartesian prisms and unaugmented cycles.
title: Exact fastest mixing and twist-parity comparison on Möbius ladders
